name: shareway-admin-panel
description: Administration panel of ShareWay: operations console in front of the API gateway.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bff,web -c cyan,magenta "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w frontend start"
scripts.build: npm -w server run build && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm -w server run lint && npm -w frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w server test && npm -w frontend test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
